verdict.rationale: Canva documents an official Apps SDK for building in-editor apps that import content, add elements and automate design tasks. It pairs this with a CLI for creating and managing apps, and offers private or public distribution. For the Connect APIs, Canva provides an OpenAPI description from which developers generate their own client SDKs rather than shipping official prebuilt ones. Missing for 10: official prebuilt Connect API client SDKs in named languages, a discoverable OpenAPI file (common paths probed 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
